title: U.S. awards SK hynix up to $458M CHIPS grant

sources.quote: The U.S. Department of Commerce awarded SK hynix up to $458 million in direct funding under the CHIPS and Science Act to establish a high-bandwidth memory (HBM) advanced packaging fabrication and research and development (R&D) facility.

Federal officials confirmed early Thursday that South Korean chip manufacturer SK Hynix Inc. will receive up to $458 million in federal CHIPS Act funding to build its $3.87 billion semiconductor packaging facility at the Purdue Research Park in West Lafayette.

explain: The government agreed to give SK hynix up to $458 million in grants for a plant in West Lafayette, Indiana that will package high-bandwidth memory (HBM), the stacked memory chips used next to AI processors.
